description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OnlineShop"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginCredentials" name="Login credentials"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginSuccessful" name="Successful login confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginFailed" name="Failed login confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderSubmitted" name="Submitted order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AddressData" name="Shipping and billing address"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OnlineShop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Shop" name="E-Shop system" processRef="Process_Shop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank" processRef="Process_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginCredentials" name="Submit login credentials" sourceRef="Task_SubmitCredentials" targetRef="Start_LoginRequest" messageRef="Message_LoginCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginSuccess" name="Successful login confirmation" sourceRef="Event_SendLoginSuccess" targetRef="Event_CatchLoginSuccess" messageRef="Message_LoginSuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginFailure" name="Failed login confirmation" sourceRef="Event_SendLoginFailure" targetRef="Event_CatchLoginFailure" messageRef="Message_LoginFailed"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderSubmitted" name="Submit order" sourceRef="Task_SubmitOrder" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrder" messageRef="Message_OrderSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentData" name="Send payment data" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentData" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentData" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Start_PaymentRequest" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentConfirmationCustomer" name="Payment confirmation to customer" sourceRef="Event_SendPaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Event_CatchPaymentConfirmationCustomer" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentConfirmationShop" name="Payment confirmation to E-Shop" sourceRef="Event_SendPaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Event_CatchPaymentConfirmationShop" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AddressData" name="Send address data" sourceRef="Task_SendAddressData" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAddressData" messageRef="Message_AddressData"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ordering process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Begin shopping"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitCredentials" name="Submit login credentials" messageRef="Message_LoginCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForLoginConfirmation" name="Wait for login confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchLoginSuccess" name="Login successful">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CatchLoginSuccess" messageRef="Message_LoginSuccessful"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchLoginFailure" name="Login failed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CatchLoginFailure" messageRef="Message_LoginFailed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginFailed" name="Shopping stops after failed login"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Select a product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckProducts" name="Check whether all products are selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" name="Are all products selected?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitOrder" name="Submit order" messageRef="Message_OrderSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CustomerWorkSplit" name="Enter payment and address details"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterPaymentData" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentData" name="Send payment data" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchPaymentConfirmationCustomer" name="Wait for bank payment confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CatchPaymentConfirmationCustomer" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterShippingAddress" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingAddressDiffers" name="Is billing address different?">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_20</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBillingAddress" name="Enter independent billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge" name="Continue with address details"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAddressData" name="Send address data" messageRef="Message_AddressData"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CustomerWorkJoin" name="Payment and address steps complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerOrderSteps" name="Payment and address steps completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_SubmitCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_SubmitCredentials" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForLoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForLoginConfirmation" targetRef="Event_CatchLoginSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForLoginConfirmation" targetRef="Event_CatchLoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Event_CatchLoginFailure" targetRef="End_LoginFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Event_CatchLoginSuccess" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_8" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_9" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_10" sourceRef="Task_CheckProducts" targetRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_11" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_SubmitOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allProductsSelected = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_12" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allProductsSelected = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_13" sourceRef="Task_SubmitOrder" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerWorkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_14" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_15" sourceRef="Task_EnterPaymentData" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_16" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentData" targetRef="Event_CatchPaymentConfirmationCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_17" sourceRef="Event_CatchPaymentConfirmationCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_18" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_19" sourceRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDiffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_20" name="Different" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDiffers" targetRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">shippingAddress != billingAddress</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_21" name="Same" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDiffers" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_22" sourceRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_23" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge" targetRef="Task_SendAddressData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_24" sourceRef="Task_SendAddressData" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_25" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerWorkJoin" targetRef="End_CustomerOrderSteps"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shop" name="E-Shop system process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_LoginRequest" name="Login credentials received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LoginRequest" messageRef="Message_LoginCredentials"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check credentials"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LoginResult" name="Were credentials valid?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Event_SendLoginSuccess" name="Send successful login confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_SendLoginSuccess" messageRef="Message_LoginSuccessful"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Event_SendLoginFailure" name="Send failed login confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_SendLoginFailure" messageRef="Message_LoginFailed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginRejected" name="Login rejected"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOrder" name="Receive submitted order" messageRef="Message_OrderSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ProcessOrder" name="Process submitted order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare payment and shipment"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Payment and shipment prepared"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InformationSplit" name="Await payment and address steps"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePaymentData" name="Receive payment data" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentRequest" name="Send payment request to bank" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchPaymentConfirmationShop" name="Receive bank payment confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CatchPaymentConfirmationShop" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAddressData" name="Receive address data" messageRef="Message_AddressData"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InformationJoin" name="Payment and address steps complete"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FinalizeOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderFinalized" name="Order finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_1" sourceRef="Start_LoginRequest" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Gateway_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_3" name="Valid" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginResult" targetRef="Event_SendLoginSuccess">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">credentialsValid = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_4" name="Invalid" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginResult" targetRef="Event_SendLoginFailure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">credentialsValid = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_5" sourceRef="Event_SendLoginSuccess" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_6" sourceRef="Event_SendLoginFailure" targetRef="End_LoginRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_7" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOrder" targetRef="Task_ProcessOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_8" sourceRef="Task_ProcessOrder" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_9" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_10" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_11" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_12" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_13" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_InformationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_14" sourceRef="Gateway_InformationSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_15" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePaymentData" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_16" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Event_CatchPaymentConfirmationShop"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_17" sourceRef="Event_CatchPaymentConfirmationShop" targetRef="Gateway_InformationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_18" sourceRef="Gateway_InformationSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAddressData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_19" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAddressData" targetRef="Gateway_InformationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_20" sourceRef="Gateway_InformationJoin" targetRef="Task_FinalizeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_21" sourceRef="Task_FinalizeOrder" targetRef="End_OrderFinalized"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Bank" name="Bank payment confirmation process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PaymentRequest" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmPayment" name="Confirm payment"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Event_SendPaymentConfirmation" name="Send payment confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_SendPaymentConfirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PaymentConfirmationSent" name="Payment confirmation sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_1" sourceRef="Start_PaymentRequest" targetRef="Task_ConfirmPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_2" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmPayment" targetRef="Event_SendPaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_3" sourceRef="Event_SendPaymentConfirmation" targetRef="End_PaymentConfirmationSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
